children: NexPoint Residential Trust reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $64.5 million, up 2.6% from $62.8 million a year earlier, while net loss attributable to common stockholders widened to $11.5 million from $7.8 million as higher expenses and interest costs outweighed revenue growth.
Revenue was $64.5M, compared with $62.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 2.6%.
Net loss attributable to common stockholders was $11.5M, compared with a $7.8M loss in the prior-year quarter.
The company owned 36 multifamily properties with 13,305 units across the Southeastern and Southwestern U.S.; occupancy was 92.8%.
Nine-month revenue increased 1.8% to $192.6M, with higher ancillary income, particularly internet, partly offsetting softer rental income.

Nine-month same-store net operating income declined 4.6%, as vacancy, rent concessions and operating costs outweighed growth in other income. Bulk internet, repairs, maintenance and utilities contributed to expense pressure.
NexPoint completed full or partial interior renovations on 1,467 units in the first nine months and expects to continue its value-add improvement program.
